title: Samphire Gratin
description: A simple yet flavorful side dish that showcases the sweetness of samphire. This gratin is a great accompaniment to a variety of main courses.
instructions: Rinse the samphire and pat it dry with a paper towel.
In a saucepan, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the samphire and sauté for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Transfer the samphire mixture to a baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the grated cheese and gratin.
Top the samphire with the cheese mixture and dot with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
